profile.headline: Elixirist
profile.summary: Passionate about strong teams & maintainable software. Not preoccupied with theory, interested in delivering high-value results.

positions.title: Development Team Lead
positions.description: Built and maintain a large social media's moderation and admin systems using elixir, liveview, OTP, rabbitMQ, and Postgres.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated sprockets to webpack
- Implemented scheduling features with stimulus and migrated backend with 0 downtime
- Planned and executed several initiatives to improve legacy systems and outdated packages

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Supported development, design, and implementation of rails-api serving mobile application
- Migrated and restructured fractured db-design to better normalized structures
- Migrated REST API to GraphQL
- Redesigned sitter application process and implemented ELM component-based frontend
- Profiled and fixed performance and memory-related issues
- Implemented updated design system based on tailwindcss
- Built elixir umbrella application servicing a full-stack scheduling system

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed existing python API, serving a react SPA
- Improved code organization and performance
- Developed documentation and developer tooling
- Implemented security-related improvements and best-practices
- Performed benchmarking and profiling POCs for Elixir

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed full stack features to support event-driven automatic assignment of student test-takers and proctoring
- Assisted in development of a microservice to facilitate multi-step identity-verification

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
New model testing and development. 
Noise and Vibration analysis. 
Experience includes maintaining production quality, mitigating complex production issues, improving current quality beyond mature specifications, and communicating necessary changes between departments. 
Projects include 2014 Acura MDX launch, 2016 Honda Pilot launch, and development/analysis of prototype engines beyond 2017 with carryover to mass production.  
Development of inner-office database tools to improve communication, workplace efficiency, and documentation all built on rails.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: C# interface and numerical programming for eddy-current navigation through BWR & PWR heat exchangers. Research & design, application, and fabrication of small robotic components.

educations.schoolName: The University of Tennessee at Chattanooga

volunteerExperiences.description: I help lead a small group of senior-high school boys in bible study and leadership skills.
